pr_title: ESQL: Use a must boolean statement when pushing down to Lucene when scoring is also needed
pr_body: Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/123967 by using a `must` statement (vs. a `filter` one) when scoring is needed in a query (enabled with `metadata _score`).
pr_comments: Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
